messages:
carla (support): Heads-up, we're getting a high-severity escalation from multiple APAC customers — streaming responses are truncating mid-output and clients are reconnecting in tight loops. Customers report partial sentences, then connection close. Example from tzhao: they saw first ~60 tokens then connection dropped.  
carla (support): Customer repro (from tzhao):
```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-lite-apac'
# gets a few chunks, then socket closes with no error payload
```
carla (support): They also see lots of 499/502 variants in their logs and a billing duplicate event for some streamed completions. Opening thread here so eng/sre can triage. @alice (sre) can you take a look?  
alice (sre): On it. I'm already seeing alerts for `sse.connection.error_rate` spiking in apac-west and proxy CPU at 92%. Correlating with an increase in write errors: `stream_write failed: broken pipe` + `connection reset by peer` in streaming-proxy.
ben (eng): Interesting — metrics show backlog in the async writer queue on streaming-proxy (write_queue_len jumped from ~10 to 600). Also noticed increased syscall EAGAIN / send() returning EPIPE in kernel logs.
eve (infra): Any recent deploys in APAC in the last 2 hours?
opsbot: Deployment alert: rolling update `streaming-proxy:v2.13.1` started 1849121900 and completed 1849122400 in apac-west.
ben (eng): That rolling update touched the proxy's write path; the new binary introduced more aggressive prefetching of token frames — possibly causing backpressure when clients retry.
alice (sre): Customer count: we have about 47 distinct tenants showing truncated streams right now, ~1.2k reconnections/min reported from APAC edge. Latency also up 150-300ms p50->p90 for streaming frames.
dave (pm): Customer-impact list? any high-touch enterprise affected?
carla (support): tzhao (finance app) and two other mid-market customers (IDs sent to dave via DM). tzhao is on a paid dedicated plan; they're escalating to accounts.
mike (client-eng): From client-side standpoint, they implement exponential backoff but their default initial retry is 100ms and max retries=10 — with many clients that becomes a thundering herd. Recommend we advise clients to increase backoff and add jitter.
tzhao (customer): Confirming — we saw many reconnects after ~50-80 tokens, then reconnect attempts every ~100-200ms. It basically killed the stream UX.
alice (sre): Short-term mitigation options I'm pushing now:
- increase per-socket write buffers on streaming-proxy (sysctl net.core.wmem_max)
- add token-bucket rate limit on connection retries at the load balancer
- route APAC SSE traffic to eu-west fallback for new connections (gradual)
- revert the prefetch change in streaming-proxy if we can do a fast rollback
ben (eng): I can cut a targeted rollback for the proxy write path and a config flip to disable prefetching; preparing PR now.
eve (infra): I'm ready to apply network sysctl bump and enable ingress retry rate-limiter in apac-ngw. Doing the sysctl first (non-disruptive).
carla (support): Noting tzhao is requesting immediate failover to EU region if we can preserve session continuity. They prefer correctness over latency.
alice (sre): Executing a traffic policy change: start routing new SSE sessions from APAC -> eu-west fallback with a soft cap (5% -> 25%) while we monitor for error reduction.
opsbot: Routing change applied: apac-west -> eu-west fallback 5% at 1849122600
ben (eng): Rolled back prefetch flag on one staging box and reproduced failure locally with aggressive client retries. With prefetch disabled, writer queue remains stable and no broken pipe observed. Preparing fast rollback to prod now.
opsbot: Config flip: disable prefetch on streaming-proxy in apac-west started at 1849123012
alice (sre): After disabling prefetch + sysctl bump + ingress rate-limiter, seeing rapid improvement: error-rate down ~75% in last 10m, reconnections/min down to ~320. Truncated stream reports from tzhao reduced to occasional.
carla (support): tzhao confirms partial improvement — still saw one truncated stream but much better. Thanks.
mike (client-eng): Sent quick client guidance: increase initial retry to 500ms, add full jitter, and stop reconnecting for stream errors that occur after >80 tokens. Also recommended clients include sequence resume support (if feasible).
alice (sre): Next steps (post-incident actions):
- full rollback of the prefetch change in apac, verify across all nodes (ben)
- implement server-side token-bucket retry-limiter and per-tenant soft caps (eve)
- add streaming-slow-path telemetry for write queue len and flush latencies (ben/alice)
- coordinate communication with affected customers + billing reconciliations for duplicate completions (carla/dave)
- write postmortem and schedule retro (owner: alice)
ben (eng): I've opened PR #5783 to revert prefetch; will cut canary deploy to two nodes first.
eve (infra): I'll provision a permanent ingress rate-limiter rule and document the sysctl changes for apac clusters.
dave (pm): We'll notify account owners and draft an incident status page entry. Carla, pls prepare a customer-facing blurb.
carla (support): Drafted short blurb and DM'ed dave for review. Also filed billing ticket to dedupe duplicates for affected time window.
alice (sre): Final status (at 1849124789): primary mitigation in place (prefetch disabled + rate-limiter + sysctl). Error rates remain ~20% of peak and we're steadily trending to normal. Moving to monitoring mode.
carla (support): tzhao: "Thanks — looks better. Please keep me posted." :thumbsup:
ben (eng): Will follow up with a non-blocking patch to introduce backpressure-aware prefetch (safer defaults) so we don't re-introduce this regression.
opsbot: Incident update recorded: incident-id INC-2026-APAC-SSE-009, severity: high, status: mitigating
alice (sre): Assigning owners for postmortem tasks in the doc. Will post link once draft is ready.
carla (support): Closing loop here for now. If anyone sees new regressions ping @alice oncall.
mike (client-eng): Quick note for SDKs: we'll add jittered-retry example and recommend 1s initial backoff for streaming. I'll open an issue.
carla (support): Thanks team. :heart:
